name: Untitled Maze Game
summary:
In Untitled Maze Game you explore a randomly generated maze. The maze which you explore is 50x50 and is designed to be difficult to find the exit.

In Untitled Maze Game the exit is a glowing wall wherein upon entry you win. Despite how simple it sounds, the game is actually pretty difficult especially as there are enemies in the maze which hunt you down and take you all the way to the beginning. The monsters in the maze that hunt you down are faster when you are walking but if you are jumping you can out-pace them.
